svg.title: 3. Coordinate layouts, one topology interface
svg.desc: Illustrative supported layouts: a four-position wrapping ring; a 3 by 3 non-wrapping mesh; a 3 by 3 wrapping torus; and three layers of a 3 by 3 by 3 torus. In the mesh, coordinates [0,0] and [2,0] are two steps apart; with wrapping they are one step apart. Selected wrap and cross-layer links illustrate the repeating pattern. Placer builds a TopologyView from the cluster configuration and eligible nodes; Pack and Spread read its distances.

g.aria-label: Node coordinates and cluster settings define neighbours and distance.
Each layer wraps along x and y too.
Dashed blue links show wrap-around; selected links illustrate the repeating pattern.
The four grid layouts feed the same placement view.
Illustrative layouts; eligible nodes determine each placement view.
